questions.text: What is an equation in mathematics?
options: A mathematical statement without an equals sign
A right term and a left term connected by an equals sign (=)
A list of numbers in a specific order
A function that maps one value to another
questions.correctAnswer: A right term and a left term connected by an equals sign (=)

questions.text: What are equivalent transformations?
options: Operations performed on only one side of the equation
Operations performed on both sides of an equation that do not change the solution set
questions.correctAnswer: Operations performed on both sides of an equation that do not change the solution set

questions.text: To solve the equation x + 5 = 12, you must subtract 5 from both sides.
How do you solve the equation x - 7 = 14?
How do you solve the equation 4x = 20?
To solve the equation x/3 = 9, you multiply both sides by 3.
What is 25% as a decimal?
To convert a percentage to a decimal, you multiply by 100.
What does 'a number increases BY 20%' mean?
options: The new number is 20% of the original
The new number is 120% of the original
questions.correctAnswer: The new number is 120% of the original

questions.text: What does 'a number increases TO 120%' mean?
options: The new number is 120% of the original
questions.correctAnswer: The new number is 120% of the original

questions.text: In percentage calculation: What is G (Grundwert/Base Value)?
options: The original value before a change
The difference between old and new value
questions.correctAnswer: The original value before a change

questions.text: In percentage calculation: What is A (Anteil/Part)?
options: The value after a change or the part of the base value
questions.correctAnswer: The value after a change or the part of the base value

questions.text: What is the basic formula for percentage calculation?
To find the base value G when A and P are known, you use the formula G = A ÷ P.
A product costs 100€. The price increases by 10%. What is the change factor?
A product costs 80€. The price is reduced by 25%. What is the new price?
The interest rate increases from 4% to 5%. This is an increase of 1 percentage point.
An interest rate increases from 5% to 6%. What is the percentage increase?
A computer costs 1600€. The price first increases by 10%, then decreases by 10%. Calculate the final price and explain why the result is not 1600€.
questions.correctAnswer: The final price is 1584€. First: 1600 × 1.10 = 1760€. Then: 1760 × 0.90 = 1584€. The result is not 1600€ because the 10% decrease is calculated on the INCREASED amount (1760€), not the original (1600€).

questions.text: Calculate: What percentage of ALL water on Earth is surface water (lakes, rivers, swamps)? Show your calculation using the given data: Saltwater 97%, Freshwater 3%, of which Surface water 0.3%.
questions.correctAnswer: Calculation: 0.03 × 0.003 = 0.0000783. As percentage: 0.0000783 × 100 = 0.00783%. So only 0.00783% of all water is surface water.
